trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Nothing extra to do here — this one pops by itself once the other 54 are ticked off. Treat the roadmap as the plan and this trophy is the finish line.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the game's first mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Just start the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: See Chapter 1 through to its last mission. There is nothing to hunt for here — the story hands it to you.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 2's missions until the chapter closes. The trophy lands when the final mission of the chapter ends.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 3 from start to finish. Side content is worth a look on the way, but the chapter trophy itself cannot be missed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 all the way through. It is the last chapter before the finale, so the story is nearly done when this pops.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the final mission for the gold story trophy. One warning first: finish the 18 meditation spots before the finale, because that is the game's only missable trophy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run shows up in the mission flow — play it through and the trophy follows.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist arrives as part of the story. No prep needed; just complete the mission.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission, so it unlocks on its own as you play.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is on the main story path — complete the mission and the trophy is yours.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: The VCIA Takedown mission opens during the airport stretch of the story. Finish it to earn this.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission — complete it and move on.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% on the stats screen means everything: story, side strands, activities, collectibles, exploration and money. Leave this until almost everything else is done, and let this checklist be the plan.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: 250 stunts sounds like a lot, but jumps, near misses, airtime and fast driving all count, and the counter never resets. Fold stunt attempts into ordinary driving instead of grinding them all at once.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once — fishing, races, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and the rest. You only need to try each one, not win it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges takes patience. Get a feel for each range's rhythm, use the right weapon for each drill, and replay the silvers until they click. Accuracy and a steady pace matter more than speed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's gates, cut the corners the track allows, and hold boost for the long straights.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only needs one win, so start with the shortest events and pick a vehicle that fits the class.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at fishing. Keep an eye on line tension, reel in while the fish runs toward you, and hold the rod steady — patience wins this one, not power.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one arcade game to its end screen at any cabinet. Short games are the fastest way to tick this off.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's last mission is the goal. His missions appear as the story moves on, so check in with him between chapters.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's final mission closes his line. His missions unlock alongside the story — take them as they come.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's last mission finishes his strand. Follow his mission line as it opens up.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands across Leonida, each played to the end. Strangers show as markers on the map; after every chapter, sweep the map again, because new strands unlock as the story advances.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's final mission is the target. Do his jobs whenever they appear in the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's final mission closes his line. It unlocks with the story, so do not leave it sitting until after the finale.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and do it while you explore each region. Some spots are in places that change as the story moves on, so do not save this for post-game cleanup. It is the only trophy in the game that can be missed.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's strand leads to a hunt for one unique animal. Follow his missions until the hunt opens, track the animal without rushing, and shoot only when it stands still.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Three complete card sets. Cards turn up across Leonida — in shops, hidden corners and mission rewards — and duplicates can be traded, so keep collecting.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The spots are spread all over the map, so clear them region by region and use the checklist to remember which areas are done.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Fifty challenges across driving, combat, exploration and more. They pile up on their own — check the challenges menu regularly and mop up the easy ones near the end.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then lose it and escape. Break line of sight, swap vehicles, and hide until the stars fade — alleys and water both help.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row with your partner, without ever losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, keep a fast car waiting, and move quickly from one to the next — do not stop to fight.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new model counts once, so drive whatever you see and wander into different neighborhoods and vehicle spots.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five enemies down in a single Combat Focus. Wait for a group to bunch up, trigger focus, and chain headshots — cramped spaces with several enemies are the ideal setup.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA without a schedule. Take a plane from the airfield and get airborne by your own route — being fast matters more than being quiet here.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks, and they are as tough as they look. Hit them with explosives and heavy weapons from cover, keep moving, and never trade shots out in the open.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Empty a jewelry store without being spotted. Stay quiet, mind the cameras and guards, take the goods and slip out before anyone sounds the alarm — silent beats loud here.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vaults robbed, five clean escapes. Sort the getaway first — a fast car and a route away from the police — then go in. One vault at a time.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, take the cash, and get away. Stash a second vehicle nearby before you start and the escape gets much easier.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: All 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and poke into every corner; the map fills in as you go, and the last areas to find are usually the remote ones.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. A different gang each time, and expect a hard fight — go in loaded.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachside spot, order a drink and enjoy the view — a calm story moment.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Out of a vehicle showroom, through the glass, in classic style. Choose a showroom, choose a fast car, and drive straight out.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Aim for the pocket and follow through.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. It comes from playing the partner story through — the trophy lands as the partnership grows.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Decisions, good or bad. The game keeps count of the choices you make, so keep choosing and this will pop as the count grows.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail once, succeed the second time. If something goes wrong, try it again — the retry is the one that counts.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: See something strange. Leonida has odd corners — keep your eyes open while exploring and something weird will find you.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by knockdown. Roll past slowly with a melee weapon ready and swing as you pass.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. It builds up across many jobs, so start moving marked bills early and keep at it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count, and the big late-game purchases finish this quickly.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: All 8 garage properties. Buy them as they become available — and they give you somewhere to keep the vehicle collection too.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Ten vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles and register each one; variety counts, duplicates do not.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
